description: This Sunday, I got invited by Dr. Alfreda Robinson to worship at Mount Pilgrim, Pastor (Representative) Nicks church (I was just there two weeks ago). The sermon, “Scorched, But Still Green,” landed on me like a word for this season of my life and this season of Arkansas politics.The message was simple, but not soft: life will scorch you, but it doesn’t get to define you. If your roots are deep enough, you stay green.That truth matters because I’m heading into a Capitol controlled by a supermajo
title: Scorched, but Still Green: My Faith is Going to Prepare Me
